model.rationale: The fundamentals strongly favor Whitesides: a D+6 district, incumbency, and a roughly ten-to-one fundraising advantage over Jason Gibbs, with markets pricing the race at 96% Democratic. A modest pullback from the baseline reflects the absence of any polling and Whitesides' narrow 2024 win in a district that flipped, but every available signal points to a comfortable incumbent win.
model.watch: Any late polling showing Whitesides under 55% or meaningful Republican outside spending entering the district would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Incumbent George T. Whitesides (D) is running.

overview:
First-term Democrat George Whitesides defends a Los Angeles County seat that leans Democratic by six points and that he flipped in 2024. He enters the general election with a decisive financial advantage, having raised about $4.0 million and holding $2.5 million on hand, while Republican Jason Gibbs has raised under $400,000 with no outside support. No independent groups are spending against the incumbent.

Prediction markets give Whitesides roughly a 96% chance of winning, and no public general-election polls are available. With the incumbent well-funded, no expert raters flagging the race as competitive, and the district's Democratic lean, this race is rated Safe Democratic, with the main caveat being the lack of direct polling in a district that was closely contested two years ago.
